description.en: Project mean-node definition identifier. The chart adapter binds it to the astronomy library's mean node; the printed Meeus formula has not been checked against the source text.
description.zh: 项目的平均交点定义标识。排盘适配层将其对应到天文库的平交点；Meeus 印刷公式本身尚未对原文核验。

description.en: Project definition identifier MEEUS_FIVE_TERM_TRUE. The chart adapter binds it to the astronomy library's true node. The identification with the five-term series is this project's, checked against the same Meeus formulas; the library does not name the series. No residual bound or equivalence to an osculating node is established here.
description.zh: 项目定义标识 MEEUS_FIVE_TERM_TRUE。排盘适配层将其对应到天文库的真交点。该交点即五项级数是本项目的认定，已用同一组 Meeus 公式对拍，天文库本身并未指明级数。此处未确立误差界或与密切轨道交点的等价关系。

description.en: Mathematical ascending-node identity using the named MEAN definition, not a physical body.
description.zh: 采用具名 MEAN 定义的数学升交点标识，不是物理天体。

description.en: Mathematical descending-node identity using the named MEAN definition, not a physical body.
description.zh: 采用具名 MEAN 定义的数学降交点标识，不是物理天体。

description.en: Mathematical ascending-node identity using MEEUS_FIVE_TERM_TRUE, not a physical body.

description.zh: 合相请求标识。精确角度 0 度；排盘实现按黄经和显式容许度判断。

definition.en: The tropical zodiac divides ecliptic longitude into twelve half-open 30-degree sectors; a longitude exactly on a sector boundary belongs to the higher sign.
definition.zh: 热带黄道把黄经分为十二个半开的 30 度区间；恰好落在区间边界上的黄经归入后一个星座。

tradition.en: Project convention for the tropical zodiac; it is not a claim about the constellations or about historical sign division.
tradition.zh: 热带黄道的项目约定；不表示关于天文星座或历史星座划分的断言。

limits.en: Applies to tropical longitudes only. The sidereal zodiac and the historical groupings in this catalog are not implemented.
limits.zh: 只适用于热带黄经。恒星黄道及本目录中的历史分组未实现。

definition.zh: 落宫使用半开区间 [宫头, 下一宫头)：恰好落在宫头上的黄经归入从该宫头开始的宫，成员关系跨 0/360 环绕。

limits.en: Uses the supplied cusp geometry only. Whether an axis coincides with a cusp is a property of the requested house system.

name.zh: Ashmand 所译托勒密的分点星座

definition.en: This edition calls Aries and Libra equinoctial signs, with the rationale preserved in the cited sentence.
definition.zh: 此版本称白羊座与天秤座为分点星座，所引整句保留其解释理由。

tradition.en: Ptolemy through the paraphrase attributed to Proclus, Ashmand's 1822 English translation; single-source historical record.
tradition.zh: 托勒密经被归于 Proclus 的转述本，由 Ashmand 于 1822 年译为英文；单源历史记录。

limits.en: Non-executable. The historical equal-day/night explanation is not a guarantee about observed daylight. It defines neither modern sign classification nor a house system or a chart interpretation.
limits.zh: 不可执行。历史原文的昼夜等长说法不保证实际日照时长；它不定义现代星座归属算法、宫制或命盘解释。

definition.en: The oriented separation runs from the first object to the second, in (-180, 180] degrees of ecliptic longitude. An aspect with exact angle theta holds when the separation differs from a branch by at most the limit, the limit included. The branches are minus and plus theta for a sextile, square or trine, and the single angle 0 or 180 for a conjunction or opposition. Every holding branch is reported, in the order of the objects, then the aspect angle, then the minus branch before the plus branch.
definition.zh: 有向间距从第一个对象指向第二个，是黄经上取值在 (-180, 180] 度内的差。精确角度为 θ 的相位，在间距与某个分支的差不超过限度时成立，限度本身包含在内。六分、四分、三分相的分支是 −θ 和 +θ，合相与对分相只有 0 或 180 这一个角度。凡成立的分支都会报告，顺序是先按对象，再按相位角，同一相位里负分支在正分支之前。

tradition.en: Project convention; it is not attributed to a tradition.
tradition.zh: 项目约定，不归于某个传统。

limits.en: Ecliptic longitude only. Latitude, declination, minor aspects, whole-sign aspects and aspects to axes are not evaluated.
limits.zh: 仅限黄经。黄纬、赤纬、次要相位、整宫相位及与轴线的相位都不判断。

definition.en: For positions and rates at one shared instant, the relative longitude rate is the second object's rate minus the first's. Away from a deviation of 180 degrees, opposite signs of the relative rate and deviation mean applying; matching signs mean separating. Zero deviation is exact. Zero relative rate with nonzero deviation is stationary: the objects have no relative motion, but either planet may still be changing longitude. A missing rate is indeterminate. At a deviation of 180 degrees with nonzero relative motion, the absolute wrapped deviation has no two-sided derivative and the status is indeterminate. Floats are compared directly, without a tolerance.
definition.zh: 对同一时刻的位置和速率，相对黄经速率是第二个对象的速率减去第一个的速率。偏差不为 180 度时，相对速率与偏差异号表示入相，同号表示离相。偏差恰为零表示精确；相对速率恰为零且偏差不为零表示静止，意思是两个对象没有相对运动，不表示某颗行星的黄经速率为零。缺少速率时为不确定。偏差恰为 180 度且存在相对运动时，回绕后的绝对偏差没有双侧导数，状态为不确定。直接比较浮点数，不使用容差。

tradition.en: Project definition; no tradition is claimed.
tradition.zh: 项目定义，不归于某个传统。

limits.en: Describes this instant only. It does not predict whether an aspect will become exact; either object may change direction before that happens.
limits.zh: 只描述当前时刻，不预测相位之后会不会变得精确；任一对象都可能在达到精确相位前改变运动方向。

name.en: Objects that take part in aspects

definition.en: In single-chart evaluation, aspects are judged among the requested objects, or among a chosen subset of them. Two lunar nodes never form an aspect with each other: the four node identities are one pair of nodes under two definitions and two directions. A node may form an aspect with a body. Axes are not objects of a chart request and take no part.
definition.zh: 在单盘判断中，相位在已请求的对象之间判断，或在其中选出的子集之间判断。两个月交点之间不构成相位：四个交点标识只是同一对交点的两种定义和两个方向。月交点可以与天体构成相位。轴线不是排盘请求里的对象，不参与。

tradition.en: Project convention; it is not attributed to a tradition.
tradition.zh: 项目约定，不归于某个传统。

limits.en: The exclusion of aspects between nodes in single-chart evaluation is a project convention. A convention that draws no aspects for a node at all is expressed by leaving the node out of the chosen subset.
limits.zh: 单盘判断中不判月交点之间的相位，是项目约定。某个惯例若根本不为月交点画相位，就把它排除在所选子集之外。

name.zh: 任一对象自己的容许度

definition.en: Each object uses its separately assigned orb, or the aspect rule's orb if none is assigned. The deviation must be within at least one object's orb, so the limit is the larger of the two orbs.
definition.zh: 每个对象使用单独设置的容许度；未单独设置时，使用相位规则的容许度。偏差在至少一个对象的容许度内就算符合，因此上限取两个容许度中较大的值。

tradition.en: Project definition; no tradition is claimed.
tradition.zh: 项目定义，不归于某个传统。

limits.en: Needed exactly when an aspect rule gives per-object orbs. The catalog supplies no default orb.
limits.zh: 仅在相位规则给出按对象的容许度时需要。目录不提供默认容许度。

name.zh: 两个对象各自的容许度

definition.en: Each object uses its separately assigned orb, or the aspect rule's orb if none is assigned. The deviation must be within both objects' orbs, so the limit is the smaller of the two orbs.
definition.zh: 每个对象使用单独设置的容许度；未单独设置时，使用相位规则的容许度。偏差必须在两个对象各自的容许度内才算符合，因此上限取两个容许度中较小的值。

tradition.en: Project definition; no tradition is claimed.
tradition.zh: 项目定义，不归于某个传统。

limits.en: Needed exactly when an aspect rule gives per-object orbs. The catalog supplies no default orb.
limits.zh: 仅在相位规则给出按对象的容许度时需要。目录不提供默认容许度。

definition.en: Each object uses its separately assigned orb, or the aspect rule's orb if none is assigned. The deviation must be within the mean of the two orbs.
definition.zh: 每个对象使用单独设置的容许度；未单独设置时，使用相位规则的容许度。偏差不超过两个容许度的平均值就算符合。

tradition.en: Project definition; no tradition is claimed.
tradition.zh: 项目定义，不归于某个传统。

limits.en: Needed exactly when an aspect rule gives per-object orbs. The catalog supplies no default orb.
limits.zh: 仅在相位规则给出按对象的容许度时需要。目录不提供默认容许度。

name.zh: 静态双盘交叉相位判断

definition.en: Pair each selected left position with each selected right position, preserving both source charts. An omitted selection means all positions on that side, independently of natal participants. Same-named objects and all named node-node pairs are allowed, including the same chart in both roles. Use caller-supplied aspect rules and identity-keyed object orbs, never either chart's natal rules. Retain every matching oriented branch, signed deviation and inclusive orb limit; no motion status is assigned.
definition.zh: 将每个所选左位置与每个所选右位置配对，保留双侧源盘。省略选择表示该侧全部位置，不继承本命参与者。允许同名对象及所有具名交点之间的配对，也允许同一张盘占两个角色。使用调用方给出的相位规则及按对象标识设置的容许度，不继承任一盘的本命规则。保留每个匹配的有向分支、带符号偏差及包含等号的容许度上限，不赋予运动状态。

tradition.en: Project geometry policy; no tradition or interpretation is claimed.
tradition.zh: 项目几何政策，不归于某个传统，也不提供解读。

limits.en: Compare matching tropical/geocentric own-date position conventions directly, without common-epoch conversion or a simultaneous spatial-angle claim. Rates at different birth instants do not establish shared evolution. No default orb, interpretation, house overlay or composite construction is supplied.
limits.zh: 在热带地心自身日期的位置坐标约定相同时直接比较，不转换共同历元，也不声称是同时刻的空间角。不同出生时刻的速率不能确立共同演化。不提供默认容许度、解读、宫位叠加或组合盘构造。

limits.en: This entry does not establish a house algorithm or an applicability domain; the chart adapter and its domain checks do. There is no default house system.

exceptions.en: Neither definition is silently substituted for another.
exceptions.zh: 两种定义不得静默互换。

limits.en: No Meeus book equation, error bound or equivalence to an osculating node has been verified here.
limits.zh: 此处未核验 Meeus 书中方程、误差界或与密切轨道交点的等价关系。

statement.zh: LunarNode 身份同时保留具名定义及升／降方向。

limits.en: Naming a direction does not define the node's motion; the chart adapter calculates the node and its longitude rate.
limits.zh: 命名方向不等于定义交点运动；排盘适配层计算交点及其黄经速率。

statement.en: MajorAspect provides five admitted identities; AspectRule requires a caller-supplied finite nonnegative orb in degrees.
statement.zh: MajorAspect 提供五种接纳的标识；AspectRule 要求调用方给出以度为单位、有限且非负的容许度。

prerequisites.zh: 请求相位须显式给出容许度。

exceptions.zh: ChartConfig 允许空的相位请求序列。

limits.en: This entry names the requests only; the evaluation is in entry.aspect_evaluation. No orb default or interpretation is supplied.
limits.zh: 此条目只列出请求标识；判断见 entry.aspect_evaluation。不提供默认容许度或解释。

statement.en: Single-chart major aspects are judged from ecliptic longitudes and an explicit orb, with the oriented branch and a local applying or separating status kept in the result.
statement.zh: 单盘主要相位按黄经和显式容许度判断，结果里保留有向分支和局部的入相或离相状态。

citations.locator: astrology 0.0.0 / src/astrology/aspects.py at the recorded commit

prerequisites.en: The caller supplies every orb; this entry gives none.
prerequisites.zh: 每个容许度都由调用方给出；此条目不提供任何容许度。

prerequisites.en: Per-object orbs need a chosen combination rule.
prerequisites.zh: 按对象的容许度需要选定一种合成规则。

exceptions.en: Two lunar nodes never form an aspect with each other in this single-chart evaluation.
exceptions.zh: 在此单盘判断中，两个月交点之间不构成相位。

limits.en: This entry is a project definition, not an independent corroboration or a traditional rule. It supplies no default orb, strength or interpretation, and a retrieval never assesses a chart.
limits.zh: 此条目是项目定义，不是独立互证或传统规则。不提供默认容许度、强度或解释，检索也从不判断命盘。

statement.en: Static major cross aspects compare two supplied natal results with distinct left/right endpoints and preserve both complete sources, without a motion field.
statement.zh: 静态主要交叉相位比较两张给定本命盘结果，区分左右端点并保留双侧完整来源，不设运动字段。

citations.locator: src/astrology/cross_aspects.py; src/astrology/aspects.py shared geometry; tests/test_cross_aspects.py at 4c2bde2b3655ac6982acc024733074f2b635079e

prerequisites.en: Two supplied immutable natal results with matching zodiac, center and position-frame conventions, plus explicit caller-supplied aspect rules.
prerequisites.zh: 两张给定不可变本命盘结果，其黄道、中心和位置坐标约定相同，并由调用方显式给出相位规则。

prerequisites.en: An orb combination is required exactly when object overrides exist; overrides may name only selected identities from either side.
prerequisites.zh: 有对象覆盖时必须给容许度合成方式，无覆盖时不能给；覆盖只能指向任一侧所选标识。

exceptions.en: Same-named objects, node-node cross pairs, the same chart in both roles, empty selections and empty rules are admitted. The single-chart node exclusion does not apply.
exceptions.zh: 允许同名对象、交点间跨盘配对、同一张盘占两个角色、空选择及空规则；单盘交点排除规则不适用。

limits.en: Project-defined geometry, not independent corroboration or traditional interpretation. Own-date longitudes are not transformed to a common epoch. No native astronomy or time resolution is needed for comparison; catalog retrieval itself never evaluates charts.
limits.zh: 项目自定几何，不是独立互证或传统解读。自身日期的黄经不转换到共同历元。比较不需要原生天文或时刻解析；目录检索本身从不判断命盘。

statement.en: Aries and Libra appear in the cited historical equinoctial-sign grouping; this catalog keeps sign names separate from calculation.
statement.zh: 白羊座与天秤座出现在所引历史分点星座分组中；本目录将星座名称与计算分开。

citations.locator: Book I, chapter XIV, printed pp. 34–35; PDF pages 72–73
astrology 0.0.0 / src/astrology/zodiac.py at the recorded commit

exceptions.en: The source is a named historical edition, not a universal definition across traditions.
exceptions.zh: 来源是一个具名历史版本，不是跨流派通用定义。

limits.en: The remaining sign names are vocabulary only; the 30-degree sector boundaries and the executable classification are a project convention in the chart implementation, not a claim from the cited edition.
limits.zh: 其余星座名称仅作词汇；30 度区间边界与可执行归属是排盘实现中的项目约定，不是所引版本的主张。

statement.en: The cited edition groups Aries and Libra as equinoctial signs. Inspecting this passage does not show that a particular chart satisfies any condition.
statement.zh: 所引版本将白羊座与天秤座列为分点星座；查到这段话不表示某张命盘满足任何条件。

citations.locator: Book I, chapter XIV, printed pp. 34–35; PDF pages 72–73; complete equinoctial-sign sentence

excerpt.en: There are also two equinoctial signs: Aries, the first after the vernal equinox; and Libra, the first after the autumnal equinox: they are so called, because the Sun, when in the first point of either, makes the day and night equal.
excerpt.zh: 分点星座也有两个：白羊座，春分之后的第一个；天秤座，秋分之后的第一个。它们如此命名，是因为太阳位于二者任一的起点时，使昼与夜等长。
excerpt.translation_credit: astrology contributors (project Chinese translation of Ashmand's English)

prerequisites.en: A chart-level use would need an explicit zodiac convention, computed position and a separately specified use of this historical grouping; these are not evaluated here.
prerequisites.zh: 若用于命盘，需要显式黄道约定、已计算的位置，以及另行明确的历史分组用法；此处未判断这些前提。

exceptions.en: The historical rationale about equal day and night is preserved, not endorsed as an observed daylight guarantee.
exceptions.zh: 保留历史原文的昼夜等长理由，不将其认可为实际日照时长保证。

limits.en: Single-source, reference-only, non-executable example. Missing prerequisites remain unresolved; computing one condition cannot turn retrieval into full applicability.
limits.zh: 单源、仅供参考、不可执行的例子。缺少的前提保持未决；算出一个条件不能使检索结果变为完全适用。
